title: Kissed Tunisian Stilton Cheese Wrap
description: A comforting, gluten-free-friendly recipe featuring the rich flavors of Stilton cheese wrapped in a crispy ssam-wrap.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped fresh herbs and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until wilted.
Wrap the ssam-wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave for 20-30 seconds to warm and soften the wrap.
Slice the Stilton cheese into thin pieces and arrange on the warmed ssam-wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, and season with salt to taste.
Fold the bottom half of the ssam-wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
